scope: One-seed natural-language diagnostic from random initialization; not a matched three-seed architecture comparison
selection_rule: Fixed learning rate from synthetic work; no BANKING77 tuning or test-based choices
evaluation: Full official test and separate calibration partitions; temperature fit on calibration only
limitation: 8000 training examples processed from a 7999-row partition; candidate byte encoding and architecture differ from Qwen. No convergence claim.
